parsed.seniority_signal: Fachliche Begleitung und Mentoring innerhalb des Teams
parsed.degree_signal: Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik, Künstlichen Intelligenz, Data Science, Robotik, Mathematik, Physik oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung, Promotion erwünscht
parsed.notes:
IHR PROFIL is the requirements section; no section heading marks its contents optional. Technologies appearing only in the introductory responsibilities and IHRE AUFGABEN are excluded.
The inline idealerweise in the ML experience bullet qualifies productive-project experience, not the requirement for Machine Learning and Deep Learning.
Generative AI and LLMs collapse to llms; Computer Vision and OpenCV collapse to computer-vision under the supplied taxonomy.
Model Optimization is left unmapped rather than assumed to mean inference optimization; on-premise/hybrid infrastructure is not assumed to mean AI Infrastructure or Cloud.
Scientific research practice is treated literally as an optional technical practice; publications, patents and open-source contributions are evidence of that practice, not separate technology skills.
The degree label records the highest named level, the optional doctorate (Promotion erwünscht); completed university studies are separately mandatory. A comparable field does not permit experience in place of a degree.
Seniority is inferred from the explicit mentoring duty, not from expert wording or the nonspecific Mehrjährige Erfahrung.
